contract.goal: Make lock replay explain exact choices, captures and selected technical edges.
negative_cases: Same-version changed definition or lost request digest cannot be accepted as exact replay.
Derived selections cannot become the only authored authority.
positive_cases: Lock preserves explicit choices and actual provider edges for offline replay.
contract.safe_stop: Keep an old lock recognizable; do not silently reinterpret unknown epochs.
steps: Serialize authored-request digest separately from active/dormant resolved selections and feature closure.
Record exact owner capture/definition, resolution domain/target, induced dependencies and selected capability providers.
Add reader migration/refusal and canonical ordering through existing generated format machinery.
contract.title: Persist requested intent separately from resolved configuration
